title: Israel strikes Beirut for the first time since ceasefire, senior Hezbollah commander killed
byline: Israel struck Beirut on Wednesday (May 6) for the first time since agreeing to a ceasefire with Hezbollah last month, with Israel saying it targeted a commander of the militant group’s elite Radwan force in the city’s southern suburbs.

title: US fires on Iranian tanker while Trump pushes for peace deal
byline: The US military fired on an Iranian oil tanker in the Gulf of Oman on Wednesday as US President Donald Trump intensified pressure on Tehran to reach a deal ending the war.

title: Hantavirus-hit cruise ship heads to Spain after three people evacuated
byline: A luxury cruise ship hit by a deadly hantavirus outbreak and marooned since Sunday off the coast of Cape Verde left for Spain on Wednesday, a Reuters witness said, after three people, two of them seriously ill, were evacuated.

title: UN warns hunger deepening in Gaza as families survive on one meal a day
byline: The UN on Wednesday warned that hunger remains widespread and severe across the Gaza Strip, with millions struggling to access adequate food despite ongoing humanitarian efforts.

title: Iran reviewing US proposal to end war, though key demands remain unaddressed
byline: Iran said on Wednesday it was reviewing a U.S. peace proposal that sources said would formally end the war while leaving unresolved the key U.S. demands that Iran suspend its nuclear program and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Fairly heavy rainfall above 75 mm expected in some parts of the island
byline: Due to the low-level atmospheric disturbance in the vicinity of Sri Lanka, the prevailing showery condition over the island is expected to continue during the next few days, the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Govt. to introduce major higher education reforms aligned with school education changes - PM
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya stated that the Government has planned to introduce relevant changes in the higher education sector in alignment with the new reforms being implemented in the primary and secondary education sectors.

title: Vietnamese President to arrive in Sri Lanka today
byline: The General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam’s Central Committee and President of Vietnam, To Lam, is scheduled to arrive in Sri Lanka tonight (07) for an official visit, accompanied by a high-level delegation.

title: Over 70 Vietnamese nationals arrested for alleged financial scams and visa violations
byline: A group of foreign nationals accused of engaging in financial scams while staying in the country in violation of visa conditions has been arrested in separate raids carried out in Colombo and Matara, according to Sri Lanka Police.

title: NPP councillor resigns from Kurunegala Municipal Council
byline: A Municipal Councillor representing the National People’s Power (NPP) in the Kurunegala Municipal Council, B. W. Premachandra, has resigned from his position.

title: Sri Lanka and Türkiye strengthen bilateral ties at second round of political consultations
byline: The Second Round of Political Consultations between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Türkiye was successfully held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Türkiye in Ankara.

title: Prices of multiple food items to increase from midnight today
byline: The All Ceylon Restaurant Owners’ Association has decided to increase the prices of Fried Rice, Biryani, and Nasi Goreng by Rs. 25 with effect from midnight today (07).

title: South Korea appeals court cuts jail term for ex-PM Han to 15 years in martial law case
byline: A South Korean appeals court on Thursday cut the jail sentence for former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo to 15 years from 23 years over his role in ex-President Yoon Suk Yeol’s brief imposition of martial law in 2024.

title: Harry Potter TV series renewed for second season at HBO
byline: The Harry Potter TV series has been renewed for a second season, with filming set to begin in autumn of this year, HBO has confirmed.

title: Rathugala indigenous leader Suda Wannila Aththo passes away
byline: The indigenous leader of Rathugala, Danigala Maha Bandalage Suda Wannila Aththo, has passed away at the age of 62.

title: Bribery Comm. refiles case against ex-CBSL Governor Cabraal
byline: The Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) has once again refiled a case before the Colombo High Court against former Central Bank Governor Ajith Nivard Cabraal...

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Central, Sabaragamuwa, Uva, North-Central, North-Western, Southern, Western, Eastern provinces and Vavuniya district.

title: Oil prices extend sharp decline as diplomacy hopes cool fears over Hormuz
byline: Oil prices extended losses on Thursday as investors weighed the prospects for a Middle East peace deal that could ease supply concerns and pave the way for the gradual reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Court orders arrest of former SriLankan CEO Kapila Chandrasena
byline: (UPDATED) The Colombo Magistrate’s Court has issued an order to arrest and produce before the court the former Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of SriLankan Airlines, Kapila Chandrasena, who had been released on bail by the court two days ago.

title: Warm weather advisory for parts of the country
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for residents of the Sabaragamuwa, Northern, North-central, North-western, Eastern provinces and Hambantota and Monaragala districts.

title: Colombo-Hanoi direct flights to be launched during Vietnamese President’s visit
byline: President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam and General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, To Lam, is scheduled to arrive in Sri Lanka tonight (07) on a state visit.

title: Rs. 10B in unpaid dues threatens Sri Lanka’s renewable energy industry survival, warns FRED
byline: The Federation of Renewable Energy Developers (FRED) warns that unless the Government steps in to resolve the financial crisis the industry is in due to the payment defaults by the National System Operator (Pvt) Limited (NSO), the domestic renewable energy sector faces a natural death.

title: UNICEF welcomes Sri Lanka’s cabinet approval of Global Charter for Child Care Reforms
byline: UNICEF has welcomed the Cabinet’s recent approval of the Global Charter for Child Care Reforms — a landmark decision that strengthens protection for children and builds momentum for Sri Lanka’s existing Alternative Care Policy.

title: Four schools in Deniyaya closed tomorrow due to spread of illness
byline: Four schools in the Deniyaya Educational Zone will remain closed tomorrow (May 08) following the advice of the Governor of the Southern Province, due to the spread of a fever-related illness, says the Zonal Education Director of Deniyaya.

title: Parliament approves extension of State of Public Emergency
byline: The motion to approve the extension of the State of Public Emergency under the Public Security Ordinance was passed in Parliament today (May 7) by a majority of 139 votes.

title: President says urgent reforms needed to eradicate drug menace in Sri Lanka
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has instructed officials to swiftly introduce all necessary reforms, including amendments to existing laws, in order to eliminate the drug menace from the country.

title: US and Iran explore short-term deal to end fighting - report
byline: The United States and Iran are edging toward a temporary agreement to halt their war, sources and officials said on Thursday, with Tehran reviewing a proposal that would stop the fighting but leave the most contentious issues unresolved.
